content_html:
Peru is an ideal destination for adrenaline lovers. With its varied geography, from the imposing Andes Mountains to the dense Amazon and the arid Pacific coast, it offers extreme experiences for all levels. If you are looking for strong emotions, here we leave you five unmissable adventures.

1. Paragliding over the Costa Verde (Lima)

If you have ever dreamed of flying, paragliding in Lima is an experience that you cannot miss. From the cliffs of Miraflores, flights offer spectacular views of the Pacific Ocean and the city. You do not need previous experience, since the flights are in tandem with an instructor. The best time is between April and December, when the winds are more stable.

2. Trekking in the Huayhuash Mountain Range (Áncash and Huánuco)

Considered one of the most challenging trekking circuits in the world, the Huayhuash Mountain Range offers impressive landscapes, with mountains more than 6,000 meters high, turquoise lagoons and glacial valleys. The entire hike takes between 8 and 12 days and is recommended for experienced hikers. If you are looking for a shorter version, there are routes of 4 to 6 days with equally spectacular views.

3. Sandboarding and tubulars in the dunes of Huacachina (Ica)

Sliding on a board through the golden dunes of the Ica desert is one of the most exciting experiences in Peru. You can sandboard while standing, like snowboarding, or lying down for maximum speed. In addition, tubular (buggie) rides are an adventure full of adrenaline, with high-speed descents and unexpected turns through the desert.

4. Rafting on the Apurímac River (Cusco and Apurímac)

Considered one of the best rivers in the world for rafting, the Apurimac offers class III, IV and V rapids in an impressive canyon. The expedition lasts between 3 and 4 days and combines pure adrenaline with spectacular landscapes. It is ideal for those looking for an intense experience in the water, although it is advisable to have some previous rafting experience.

5. Bungee Jumping in the Sacred Valley (Cusco)

If you want to feel the maximum adrenaline rush, the Action Valley bungee jumping in Cusco is the highest in South America, with a free fall of 122 meters. It is an extreme experience, only suitable for the brave, where you will feel gravity like never before.
